notes: Six new card and party tables: Bullsh*t!, Basic Rummy, Old Maid, Cockroach Poker, original Cards Against Humanity-style prompts, and original meme captions/pictures. Manual bluff calls, melds, hidden draws and human judging; original illustrated critters/scenes, familiar avatars, animated cards and recorded sound effects. Play solo against public-information bots where appropriate, or together in online/Bluetooth rooms. Two-player judged games offer a cooperative House duo or unscored freeplay; computers never judge humor. Includes private hands, explicit rules, save/resume, replay and measured performance records. Existing approved game designs, rooms, profiles and saved scores are retained.
